_comment: MADR config TEMPLATE — annotated reference showing every top-level field. Copy and adapt for your own runs. Comments here document what each field does.
_path_replacement_notice: All /path/to/... values are placeholders. Replace them with paths from your own model installation and dataset before running.
_doc_model_combination: Selects executor + prompts/. One of: vic_routing | vic_cama_flood | swat. Defaults to vic_routing for backward compatibility.
_doc_max_rounds: 0 = derive from sum of per-phase max_rounds. >0 = override global cap.
_doc_evaluation_period: Optional metric window inside simulation_period. Use it to exclude spin-up years. ISO start_date/end_date are also accepted.
_doc_model_binding: mode: real | simulate (simulate skips the heavy binaries for plumbing tests).
_doc_executables: Only the ones your model_combination needs. SWAT+ uses swatplus_exe; CaMa-Flood adds cama_flood_exe; VIC+routing uses vic_exe + rout_exe.
_doc_mc_selection_metric: mean_nse or j_total. SWAT+ should normally use j_total so every accepted strategy and cross-round center is one watershed-level joint bundle.

phase_config._doc: Per-phase hard caps and patience. VIC-based combinations track in-phase mean NSE; SWAT+ tracks acceptance of the configured watershed-level joint objective. Multi-candidate rounds do not increment patience. Set patience_rounds to 999 to force the full phase budget.

param_ranges._doc: Tunable parameter ranges. Names and count depend on model_combination.

initial_exploration._doc: 50-sample initial exploration (10 Gaussian + 40 LHS) — provides soft contextual evidence to LLM agents. enabled=false to skip.

leader._doc: Leader LLM config. The values below are one tested API example, not a restriction on other API-accessible models or compatible endpoints.

workers._doc: One Worker per sub-basin. Topology defined by neighbors_downstream.
